terminalSequence.description: A terminal escape sequence Claude Code emits for the hook: only OSC 0, 1, 2, 9, 99, 777 and BEL. Anything else makes the field ignored. Interactive sessions only, and not from an async hook.

title: StopFailure hook output
description: Claude Code reads no decision from this event; a hook here is for side effects. The output and exit code are ignored, apart from terminalSequence. Claude Code discards continue, systemMessage, stopReason on this event.
